 Akabane Karma (赤羽 業) is a student in Class 3-E of Kunugigaoka Middle School led by Korosensei.  Karma was once suspended for his violent behavior.

Appearance: Karma has short red hair and yellow eyes.  Behind the innocent, always smiling face is a ruthless and brutal person.  He has a slim build and also shows that he has sharp fangs.

 Outfit: Out of all the members of Class 3-E, Karma is the only one to wear a black blazer, contrary to the school uniform.  In the anime, Karma is considered attractive by the girls out of all the boys in Class E if he were a little more decent.

Family background: Karma comes from a wealthy family, as his parents are successful financial traders.  They are "free" people who spend most of their time traveling around the world, and as a result they spend very little time with Karma.

Personality: Karma is famous throughout the school for his violent behavior and annoying attitude.  He is quite clever, naughty, and somewhat cruel, often playing dirty, deceiving, and sometimes manipulating, humiliating, and fighting with others.

 Hobbies: Karma is quite laid back most of the time as he sometimes skips over things that he finds boring, such as school.  However, he worked harder in studying after the embarrassing exam even though he hid it by making it look like he was playing a video game.  Unexpectedly, Karma is a fan of superhero movies, like Sonic Ninja

 Surprise: Despite his slightly cruel nature, Karma actually has good values behind his motives, and is quite empathetic.

Intelligence: Karma is one of the most intelligent characters in the series, capable of maintaining top scores without much effort.  He possesses his cunning, naughty yet substantial objective nature for assassination plots, as well as other situations that may require it, such as saving his classmates or others.  .  He is also usually the first to notice any strange things that might be happening around and in Class E.

 Combat Skills: Besides his intelligence, Karma possesses a fighting field and enjoys it.  He has good combat skills such as high mobility and reflexes, and also has a mind suitable for pranks and foul play.  He is also the strongest student physically in Class E
